gate1.reason: two independent walls block emulator reproduction

wall_1.description: App traffic does not need the tunnel at all — emulator host NAT reaches Mac tailnet IP directly, bypassing tsnet/SOCKS entirely
wall_1.evidence: w-up-probe: pre-fix APK upload to tailnet IP succeeded in <1s without SOCKS

wall_2.description: tsnet tunnel has WireGuard direct-connect fallback — blocking DERP TCP does not cut tsnet routing because tsnet negotiates WireGuard direct path when both nodes are on same tailnet

evidence.ss_after_drop: 10.0.2.16:52622 → 43.136.53.247:8444 ESTABLISHED (persisted through DROP — kernel state not flushed)
evidence.goLog_after_daemon_kill: I/GoLog(5967): socks5: client connection failed: connect tcp 100.75.207.88:19983: connection was refused
evidence.interpretation: 'connection refused' proves tsnet routed to Mac (daemon down, port closed), not 'no route to host' — WireGuard direct path active despite DERP DROP

gate1.gate1_satisfied_by: user A/B diff on real device (authoritative) + JVM probes (structural proof)

probes.name: probe1 state 停在 Up 且 ensureStarted 因幂等守卫不重启节点
probes.meaning: idempotency guard at TsnetWire.kt:91 blocks restart when state is Up — backend.startCount stays 1

probes.name: probe2 SOCKS 端口关闭后 socketFactoryFor 仍返回 SOCKS 工厂无健康检查
probes.meaning: socketFactoryFor only reads state, no liveness check — returns SOCKS factory even when SOCKS port is closed

probes.name: probe3 多次 ensureStarted 均被幂等守卫拦截 state 永久停在 Up
probes.meaning: 5 repeated ensureStarted calls all blocked — no self-heal mechanism, state permanently Up

confirmed_tailnet_path_on_emulator.description: Flow confirmed active via tsnet SOCKS (separate from DERP-block test)
evidence: App top-bar switched from 'LAN' to 'tailnet' after manual pairing with TS authkey
Session screen showed alauda@MacBook-Pro app % (connected via tailnet)
GoLog: socks5: client connection failed: connect tcp 100.75.207.88:19983: connection was refused

root_cause.summary: TsnetWire.state semantics mismatch: 'Up' means 'start() succeeded once', not 'SOCKS currently routable'. Three independent defects conspire: (1) idempotency guard blocks restart, (2) socketFactoryFor has no health check, (3) no foreground-resume trigger for ensureStarted.
root_cause.fix_recommendation: failure-driven restart: SOCKS CONNECT failure as trigger for notifySocksRouteFailure() → forceRestartWithCurrentKey(), 30s throttle, guarded by state.Up check to avoid false triggers on LAN path

cross_task.note: HttpUrlConnectionUploader inherits the same fragility (same SOCKS path). Fix in TsnetWire layer covers both upload and WebSocket. No per-uploader restart logic needed.
